Every command in the guide runs as written. The guide keeps this example:

```sh
1. pnpm install
- vp check
(1) not an item
```

1. `vp check` passes on a clean checkout.
2) The guide names the version it was checked with.
   It says where the command came from.
・ The changelog mentions the guide.
① The release notes link to it. ② The README links to it too.
